title: Macroparticles with different weights relax to different temperatures in Particle-In-Cell simulations
summary: A distinctive feature of Particle-In-Cell (PIC) simulations is the use of macroparticles, each representing many physical particles. The associated macroparticle weight can vary from one species to another, or even from one macroparticle to another. Here we show that, when macroparticles have different weights, the plasma evolves toward an unphysical thermal equilibrium in which the temperatures are unequal: lower-weight macroparticles reach a higher temperature than physically expected, and higher-weight macroparticles a lower one. We show that this unphysical equilibrium is difficult to avoid, but that reaching it takes time, and that the associated timescale depends on the effective collisionality of the PIC algorithm. We derive an equation that predicts the full time evolution of the temperatures, in good agreement with PIC simulations, and use it to identify strategies to delay the establishment of this unphysical thermal equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了PIC（粒子网格）模拟中一个重要的物理问题：当宏粒子具有不同权重时，等离子体会演化到非物理的热平衡状态——低权重宏粒子达到比物理预期更高的温度，而高权重宏粒子温度更低。作者推导出预测温度完整时间演化的方程，与PIC模拟结果高度一致，并据此提出延迟这种非物理热平衡建立的策略。
AI.motivation: PIC模拟使用宏粒子（每个代表大量物理粒子）是该方法的核心特征，宏粒子权重可能因种类或个体而异。然而，不同权重的宏粒子会导致非物理的热平衡——温度分布不均（低权重粒子更热，高权重粒子更冷），这与真实物理不符。理解这一现象的机制和产生时间尺度，对于正确设计和解释PIC模拟至关重要。
AI.method: 作者通过理论推导和PIC模拟验证相结合的方式：(1) 识别出不同权重宏粒子导致非物理热平衡的机制；(2) 证明该非物理平衡难以避免但达到需要时间，时间尺度取决于PIC算法的有效碰撞性；(3) 推导出能够预测温度完整时间演化的方程；(4) 利用该方程识别延迟非物理热平衡建立的策略。
AI.result: 成功推导出能够准确预测宏粒子温度随时间演化的方程，与PIC模拟结果高度吻合。揭示了温度不平衡产生的根本原因，并基于方程提出了延迟非物理热平衡建立的具体策略。
AI.conclusion: 不同权重宏粒子的PIC模拟不可避免地趋向于一个非物理的热平衡态（温度不均等），但该过程有时间尺度且可被延迟。所推导的预测方程可用于指导模拟参数选择，以在实际模拟时间窗口内维持物理有效性。

title: A sharp-diffuse interface model for intermittent and isolated topological transitions
summary: We propose a hybrid sharp-diffuse interface representation for modeling intermittent and isolated topological transitions during Cahn-Hilliard phase coarsening. Away from topological events, the evolution is approximated by the Mullins-Sekerka sharp-interface limit system and computed using a boundary integral formulation. When diffuse transition layers overlap, a novel interface surgery algorithm resolves topology changes through a localized Cahn-Hilliard pseudo-time evolution, after which the sharp-interface calculation is resumed. We develop the mathematical formulation underlying this decomposition, present a simple two-dimensional numerical implementation, and simulate a mass-exchange problem with interface coalescence. By localizing the diffuse evolution to topological events, the method achieves a speedup of two to three orders of magnitude over conventional diffuse-interface simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合尖锐-弥散界面表示方法，用于模拟Cahn-Hilliard相粗化过程中的间歇性拓扑转变。远离拓扑事件时采用Mullins-Sekerka尖锐界面极限系统（边界积分方法）求解；当弥散过渡层重叠时，通过新型界面手术算法利用局部Cahn-Hilliard伪时间演化实现拓扑变化，随后恢复尖锐界面计算。数值实现表明该方法比传统弥散界面模拟快2-3个数量级。
AI.motivation: Cahn-Hilliard相粗化过程中存在间歇性的拓扑转变（如界面合并），传统的弥散界面方法在整个演化过程中计算成本高昂，而尖锐界面方法难以处理拓扑变化。需要一种能够结合两种方法优势的混合策略。
AI.method: 1) 远离拓扑事件时，采用Mullins-Sekerka尖锐界面极限系统，用边界积分公式求解演化；2) 当弥散过渡层重叠时，触发界面手术算法，通过局部Cahn-Hilliard伪时间演化处理拓扑变化；3) 拓扑事件解决后恢复尖锐界面计算。作者发展了该分解的数学公式，并提出简单二维数值实现。
AI.result: 通过将弥散演化局部化到拓扑事件区域，该方法实现了2-3个数量级的加速，并成功模拟了具有界面合并的质量交换问题。
AI.conclusion: 混合尖锐-弥散界面表示方法能够高效且准确地处理Cahn-Hilliard相粗化中的间歇性拓扑转变，兼具尖锐界面的计算效率与弥散界面的拓扑灵活性。

title: Can Strain or Anion Interchange Make an Unstable Structure Stable? Energetics, Lattice Dynamics and Strain-Tunable Band Gaps of Lithium Chalcohalide Antiperovskites (Li$_{3}$$BA$) and their Anion Interchange Variants (Li$_{3}$$AB$)
summary: Lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites are a promising, non-toxic alternative to lead halide perovskites, with potential as solid electrolytes for Li-ion batteries. we computationally investigate a relatively unexplored anion-interchange mechanism by which cubic Li$_{3}$$AB$ derivatives are obtained from the parent cubic antiperovskite Li$_{3}$$BA$ ($A$ = O, S, Se, Te, Po; $B$ = F, Cl, Br, I). The calculated relative energy landscape provides a useful guide for anion-site selectivity and its role in structural stability. The energetic stability results reveal that the smaller anion inside the octahedron stabilizes the structures. The lattice-dynamic calculations confirm that Li$_{3}$F$A$ ($A$ = Te, Po) and Li$_{3}$O$B$ ($B$ = Cl, Br, I), which are the most energetically stable compounds, are dynamically stable cubic phases without imaginary phonon modes. However, Li$_{3}$FS and Li$_{3}$FSe, while energetically stable, are dynamically unstable at equilibrium and become dynamically stable under triaxial compressive strain. In addition, we report the electronic structure and density of states (DOS) of all compounds, which show a substantial change in band gap upon anion interchange. The strain engineering of the lithium chalcohalide family illustrates how a few percent of the strain can tune the electronic band gap within the electrochemical stability window for solid battery applications. This study unveils essential characteristics of the anion site-interchange mechanism and provides a foundation for the understanding and design of lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算系统研究了锂硫卤化物反钙钛矿中阴离子互换机制，发现较小阴离子占据八面体中心可稳定结构，并揭示了几种化合物的动态稳定性特征及应变工程对电子带隙的调控作用。
AI.motivation: 锂卤化物反钙钛矿是铅卤化物钙钛矿的无毒替代品，可作锂离子电池固态电解质，但阴离子互换机制及其对结构稳定性的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 采用计算材料学方法（相对能量计算、晶格动力学计算、电子结构与态密度计算），对Li3AB与Li3BA（A=O,S,Se,Te,Po; B=F,Cl,Br,I）阴离子互换体系进行系统研究，并考虑三轴压缩应变对动态稳定性的影响。
AI.result: 较小阴离子在八面体内部可稳定结构；Li3FA（A=Te,Po）和Li3OB（B=Cl,Br,I）是最稳定的立方相且无虚频；Li3FS和Li3FSe在平衡状态动态不稳定，但可在三轴压缩应变下变得稳定；阴离子互换显著改变带隙，少量应变可在电化学稳定窗口内调节电子带隙。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了阴离子位点互换机制的关键特性，为理解和设计锂硫卤化物反钙钛矿提供了基础，并展示了应变工程在固态电池应用中的潜力。

title: Weak irreducibility as a spectral criterion for phase coexistence
summary: Conventional finite-size theories describe first-order coexistence through free-energy competition and interfacial tunneling, but the distinct spectral roles of sector balance and inter-sector connectivity are not usually explicit. We show that pseudo-transitions and thermodynamic phase coexistence are governed by two spectral coordinates: sector imbalance locates balance, while connectivity determines whether that balance remains avoided. AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统一的理论框架，通过两个谱坐标（扇区不平衡和扇区间连通性）来刻画一阶相变共存现象。研究发现，伪相变与真实热力学相共存由这两种谱坐标共同决定：扇区不平衡决定平衡位置，连通性决定平衡是否被避免。对于短程系统，正的界面张力会指数级抑制连通性，从而恢复可约性并产生真实的相共存；而一维伪相变则保持有限连通性。作者在双层Ising模型中验证了这一理论。
AI.motivation: 传统有限尺寸理论通过自由能竞争和界面隧穿来描述一阶相变共存，但扇区平衡与扇区间连通性的不同谱作用没有被明确区分。作者希望揭示这两种机制在相变理论中的独立角色，从而更清晰地理解伪相变与真实热力学相共存的本质区别。
AI.method: 作者提出两个谱坐标来刻画相变共存问题：(1) 扇区不平衡，用于定位平衡点；(2) 扇区间连通性，决定平衡是否被避免。通过对有限连通性系统在对称化双扇区表示中的分析，并结合短程系统界面张力的指数级抑制效应，建立了统一的谱理论框架，并在修饰双层Ising模型上进行了验证。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：在平衡点处，有限连通性产生一个具有相等谱权重的唯一主导态；短程系统中正的界面张力使连通性被指数级抑制，导致共存劈裂闭合并渐近恢复可约性；真实相共存表现为有限尺寸避免共存的奇异极限，而一维伪相变保持有限连通性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了扇区平衡与连通性在一阶相变理论中的独立谱学角色，为区分伪相变与真实热力学相共存提供了清晰的判据，并在修饰双层Ising模型中通过共存间隙的独立估算得到了验证。

title: Wide-Field Opto-Iontronic iSCAT Mapping of Interfacial Charging and Electrical Connectivity
summary: Spatial variations in electrical connectivity and interfacial ion accumulation can strongly influence electrochemical performance, yet these properties are difficult to visualize directly with conventional ensemble measurements. Here, we introduce potential-modulated opto-iontronic microscopy, an interferometric scattering microscopy (iSCAT) approach for wide-field imaging of electric-double-layer (EDL) dynamics at nanostructured electrodes. Sinusoidal potentials were applied to focused-ion-beam-fabricated indium tin oxide (ITO) nanoholes, and the optical response was extracted at the modulation frequency by Fourier demodulation. The optical modulation amplitude increased approximately linearly with modulation voltage above a low-voltage roll-off and decreased with increasing frequency, consistent with kinetically limited interfacial charging. We then mapped the potential-synchronized optical amplitude across patterned ITO electrodes. Electrically isolated blocks exhibited strongly suppressed modulation signals, whereas electrically connected and partially milled nanogrid structures showed pronounced responses. These results demonstrate label-free optical mapping of local charging dynamics and electrical connectivity at heterogeneous electrochemical interfaces using a commercially available iSCAT platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于干涉散射显微镜（iSCAT）的电位调制光离子电子显微镜技术，用于对纳米结构电极上的双电层（EDL）动力学进行宽场成像，无需荧光标记即可绘制异质电化学界面的局部充电动力学和电连接性。
AI.motivation: 传统集合测量方法难以直接可视化电极表面电连接性和界面离子积累的空间变化，而这些性质对电化学性能有重要影响，因此需要一种能够直接宽场成像EDL动力学的方法。
AI.method: 在聚焦离子束制备的氧化铟锡（ITO）纳米孔上施加正弦电位，通过傅里叶解调在调制频率处提取光学响应；随后扫描电极阵列，绘制电位同步的光学振幅图来映射局部充电动力学和电连接性。
AI.result: 光学调制振幅随调制电压近似线性增加（在低电压滚降区之上），并随频率增加而减小，符合动力学受限的界面充电行为。电隔离块表现出强烈抑制的调制信号，而电连接及部分铣削的纳米网格结构则显示明显的响应。
AI.conclusion: 利用商用iSCAT平台成功实现了异质电化学界面局部充电动力学和电连接性的无标记光学映射，为研究电化学界面提供了新工具。

title: Intertwined spin-charge stripe order and polar lattice distortion in La$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$O$_{7}$
summary: The low-temperature density-wave state of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ hosts pronounced spin-density-wave (SDW) order, while recent experiments further reveal charge redistribution and a concomitant lattice-symmetry lowering. However, the microscopic relationship among spin, charge, and lattice remains unclear. Using first-principles calculations, we investigate the pressure evolution of the electronic structure and static spin susceptibility of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, together with the energetics and lattice response of representative magnetic configurations. We trace the SDW instability to strong Fermi-surface nesting and find that the high-pressure spin response closely tracks $T_{\mathrm C}$, suggesting spin-fluctuation-mediated pairing. Among the candidate magnetic states considered, the spin-charge-stripe states emerge as energetically favored and dynamically stable, developing pronounced disproportionation of both the local Ni moments and the Ni--O bond lengths. Remarkably, the lowest-energy a-stripe state spontaneously relaxes into the experimentally proposed polar Am2m structure through a polar distortion along the b axis. These results establish a unified picture in which spin, charge, and lattice responses are strongly intertwined in the low-pressure density-wave state, while spin fluctuations remain a plausible ingredient of superconductivity under pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了La₃Ni₂O₇中自旋、电荷与晶格之间的耦合关系，发现自旋-电荷-条纹态在能量上有利且动力学稳定，最低能的a条纹态自发弛豫到实验提出的极性Am2m结构，建立了低压制密度波态中自旋、电荷、晶格强耦合的统一图像，同时支持高压下自旋涨落介导的超导配对机制。
AI.motivation: 尽管实验已揭示La₃Ni₂O₇低温密度波态中存在显著的自旋密度波序、电荷再分布以及伴随的晶格对称性降低，但自旋、电荷与晶格之间的微观关系仍不清楚，需要从理论上阐明它们如何相互耦合。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，研究La₃Ni₂O₇电子结构和静态自旋磁化率随压力的演化，并结合代表性磁构型的能量学和晶格响应分析；检验费米面嵌套导致的SDW不稳定性，评估不同磁态的能量优势和动力学稳定性。
AI.result: 发现SDW不稳定性源于强费米面嵌套；高压下的自旋响应与T_C紧密关联，支持自旋涨落介导的配对；自旋-电荷-条纹态在能量上更有利且动力学稳定，表现出显著的Ni局域磁矩和Ni-O键长的不等化；最低能的a条纹态自发弛豫到极性Am2m结构。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了统一图像：在低压密度波态中自旋、电荷和晶格响应强耦合，而在高压下自旋涨落是超导性的合理候选配对机制，为理解该材料中密度波态与超导性的关系提供了理论框架。

title: Quantum encoding of structured light into in-plane topological spin textures
summary: Structured light offers a powerful means of controlling light-matter interactions through multiple tunable optical degrees of freedom. Using micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the nucleation of asymmetric bimerons and antibimerons by pulsed Laguerre-Gaussian optical vortices in chiral ferromagnetic thin films with $C_{nv}$ and $D_{2d}$ symmetries, respectively. For optical vortices with orbital angular momentum (OAM) $|m|=1$, circularly polarized beams deterministically nucleate a single bimeron or antibimeron via the interplay of spin angular momentum, OAM, and magnetic chirality, whereas linearly polarized beams produce textures whose topological charge directly follows the OAM ($Q=m$). Optical vortices with OAM $|m|>1$ nucleate clusters and other configurations composed of multiple spin textures, whose morphology and topological charge depend sensitively on the optical quantum numbers and pulse parameters. These findings reveal a route to topology-selective writing through the encoding of optical quantum numbers into distinct in-plane topological magnetic states.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微磁模拟研究了拉盖尔-高斯光学涡旋脉冲在具有C_nv和D_2d对称性的手性铁磁薄膜中核化不对称双半子（bimeron）和反双半子（antibimeron）的机制，发现轨道角动量、自旋角动量和磁手性的相互作用可实现拓扑选择性写入。
AI.motivation: 结构化光通过多个可调光学自由度提供了控制光与物质相互作用的强大手段。本文旨在探索利用光学涡旋的轨道角动量等量子数来精确调控拓扑磁结构的核化过程，实现拓扑选择性写入。
AI.method: 采用微磁模拟方法，研究脉冲拉盖尔-高斯光学涡旋在手性铁磁薄膜中的双半子/反双半子核化。分别考察圆偏振和线偏振光束，以及不同OAM阶数(|m|=1和|m|>1)对核化结果的影响。
AI.result: 对于OAM |m|=1：圆偏振光束通过自旋角动量、OAM和磁手性的相互作用确定性核化单个双半子或反双半子；线偏振光束产生的纹理拓扑电荷直接等于OAM（Q=m）。对于OAM |m|>1：核化由多个自旋纹理组成的簇及其他构型，其形态和拓扑电荷敏感依赖于光学量子数和脉冲参数。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了将光学量子数编码为不同的面内拓扑磁态的路径，为拓扑选择性写入提供了新的机制和手段。

title: Large scale theoretical investigation of the phase diagram of twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ at fractional fillings: agreements and contradictions with current experiments
summary: We present a comprehensive exact-diagonalization study of interaction-driven phases in twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ across experimentally relevant twist angles ($2.13^\circ$--$4^\circ$) and hole fillings. Using continuum-model moiré bands, we compare the one-band-per-valley (1BPV) projection with a two-band-per-valley (2BPV) calculation that includes interaction-driven band mixing, and we benchmark both the widely used first-harmonic continuum model and a parameter-free DFT ``fitting-free'' model. At odd-denominator fillings, the 2BPV calculation reproduces the experimentally observed hierarchy of fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) around $θ\approx 3.7^\circ$, including robust incompressible states at $ν=-2/3$, $-3/5$, and $-4/7$ while correctly finding the absence of an FCI at $ν=-3/7$, and it favors a charge density wave ground state at $ν=-1/3$ over the FCI. At half filling $ν=-1/2$, the 1BPV calculation exhibits clear composite Fermi liquid (CFL) signatures, whereas the band mixing in 2BPV calculations destabilizes the CFL ground state. Finally, motivated by the Landau-level analogy at $θ\approx 2.13^\circ$, we test the proposed non-abelian Pfaffian state at $ν=-3/2$ in the fully-polarized spin sector but find no evidence for this state within the models and parameters studied. Our results establish a unified numerical benchmark for correlated and topological phases in twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ and clarify where multi-band physics is essential for a quantitative comparison with experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文对扭转双层MoTe₂在实验相关转角（2.13°–4°）和空穴填充下开展了全面的精确对角化研究，比较了单带/双带投影模型及两种连续模型，揭示了分数陈绝缘体（FCI）的层级、复合费米液体（CFL）的稳定性以及非阿贝尔Pfaffian态的缺失，为实验对比建立了统一的数值基准。
AI.motivation: 扭转双层MoTe₂中实验观测到多种相互作用驱动的拓扑相（如FCI、CFL等），但以往理论研究多采用简化的一带每谷（1BPV）投影和首谐波连续模型，忽略了能带混合效应以及不同连续模型间的差异。为准确理解实验现象并厘清多带物理在定量对比中的重要性，需要系统全面的数值研究。
AI.method: 采用精确对角化方法，基于连续模型构造莫尔能带；对比1BPV（单带每谷）与2BPV（双带每谷，包含相互作用驱动的能带混合）两种投影方案；同时基准测试广泛使用的首谐波连续模型和无参数DFT拟合模型；在奇分母填充、半填充以及ν=-3/2三个场景下分别考察FCI、CFL和Pfaffian态。
AI.result: 1) 2BPV在奇分母填充下重现实验观测的FCI层级（ν=-2/3, -3/5, -4/7为不可压缩态，ν=-3/7无FCI），且在ν=-1/3偏好电荷密度波而非FCI；2) 在ν=-1/2处1BPV显示清晰CFL特征，但2BPV的能带混合破坏CFL基态；3) 在θ≈2.13°的ν=-3/2全极化自旋扇区未发现Pfaffian态证据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为扭转双层MoTe₂中的关联和拓扑相建立了统一的数值基准，明确指出多带物理（能带混合）对定量与实验对比至关重要，同时揭示了现有简化模型在描述某些相（如CFL和Pfaffian态）时的局限性。

title: Tunable Magnetic Frustration in the Cu-Ru-based Double Perovskite La$_{2-x}$Sm$_x$CuRuO$_6$ (x = 0, 1, 2) Oxides
comment: 21 pages, 16 figures; Accepted for Publication in PRB, in production
summary: In this study, we investigate structural, magnetic, and electronic properties of the copper-ruthenate based oxide double perovskite La$_{2-x}$Sm$_x$CuRuO$_6$ (x = 0, 1, 2), synthesized through the solid-state reaction method. X-ray diffraction analysis reveals that all compounds crystallize in a monoclinic symmetry, with varying degree of structural distortion that increases in moving from La$^{3+}$ to smaller size cation Sm$^{3+}$. Electrical resistivity studies indicate insulating behaviour in all compounds, with variable-range-hopping domination at low temperatures, due to presence of anti-site disorder. AC susceptibility and heat capacity measurements suggest suppression of frustration in Sm-bearing compounds, affecting the magnetic behavior. Our first-principles calculations suggest that the combined effects of lattice distortion and Sm magnetism play a crucial role in weakening magnetic frustration, thereby rationalizing the experimental observations. These findings shed light on the complex interplay of crystal structure and magnetism in Cu-Ru double perovskites, and open up an avenue for tuning of magnetic properties through rare-earth-ion substitution.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过固态反应法合成了铜钌酸盐双钙钛矿La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆ (x=0,1,2)，系统研究了其结构、磁性和电子性质。所有化合物均呈单斜对称，结构畸变随Sm³⁺取代而增大；电输运表现为绝缘行为，低温下以变程跃迁为主导；Sm的引入抑制了磁阻挫，第一性原理计算表明晶格畸变与Sm磁性共同削弱了磁阻挫效应。
AI.motivation: 探索Cu-Ru双钙钛矿体系中晶体结构与磁性之间的复杂相互作用，并通过稀土离子取代来调控磁性质，理解磁阻挫的起源及其抑制机制。
AI.method: 采用固态反应法合成样品；X射线衍射分析晶体结构；电输运测量研究导电行为；交流磁化率和比热测量表征磁性；结合第一性原理计算解释实验现象。
AI.result: 所有化合物均呈单斜结构，Sm³⁺取代增大结构畸变；所有样品显示绝缘行为，低温下变程跃迁主导；Sm替代抑制磁阻挫，改变磁行为；第一性原理计算证实晶格畸变与Sm磁性共同削弱磁阻挫。
AI.conclusion: 晶格畸变与稀土离子磁性协同作用可有效调节Cu-Ru双钙钛矿的磁阻挫程度，为通过稀土取代调控磁性提供了新的途径。

title: Entropy Production Bounds the Accuracy of Computation in Markov Networks
summary: Biological and artificial networks compute by transforming time-dependent inputs into functional outputs. Because the internal state of a stochastic network relaxes on finite timescales, its output generally lags behind a changing environment, producing computational errors. We show that for reversible continuous-time Markov networks the error admits a universal thermodynamic bound. Decomposing the total error into representation and lag contributions, we derive an inequality relating the lag error to the entropy production rate and a memory time equal to the integrated equilibrium autocorrelation of the output observable. The bound implies that accurate dynamical computation requires either substantial dissipation or long-lived memory encoded in slowly relaxing modes. We demonstrate these principles in artificial Markov networks and in models of biochemical information processing. Our results establish a thermodynamic limit on information processing in stochastic networks and provide a quantitative framework for understanding the energetic costs of biological computation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明可逆连续时间马尔可夫网络中动力计算误差存在一个普适热力学界，将滞后误差与熵产生率和记忆时间联系起来，表明精确的动态计算必须依赖于大量耗散或长寿命记忆。
AI.motivation: 生物和人工网络依赖时变输入进行计算，但由于随机网络内部状态在有限时间尺度上弛豫，输出会滞后于环境变化而产生计算错误。此前缺乏对这些计算误差的普适热力学限制的定量理解。
AI.method: 将总误差分解为表示误差和滞后误差两部分，推导出滞后误差与熵产生率及记忆时间（输出可观测量积分的平衡自相关）之间的不等式，并在人工马尔可夫网络和生化信息处理模型中进行验证。
AI.result: 推导出误差的热力学下界：高精度动态计算必然要求显著耗散或由慢弛豫模式编码的长寿命记忆；该原理在人工马尔可夫网络和生化信息处理模型中均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了随机网络中信息处理的热力学极限，为理解生物计算的能量成本提供了定量框架。

title: Differential Learning for Robust Prediction of Thermal Stability with Application to Energetic Materials
summary: Predicting thermal stability during handling and storage is essential for the design of safe and reliable energetic materials. However, experimental measurements vary significantly across laboratories due to differences in protocols and analysis methods, making it difficult to train reliable predictive models. We address this challenge through differential learning. Rather than predicting absolute decomposition temperatures, we instead train message passing neural networks to predict relative differences between pairs of molecules. This approach reduces sensitivity to systematic experimental errors and achieves >85% accuracy in ranking compounds by thermal stability, outperforming conventional regression methods on the same heterogeneous dataset. To understand what drives these predictions, we compare neural network models with interpretable alternatives built from descriptors derived from ab initio calculations and cheminformatics software. This analysis identifies bond dissociation enthalpy as a key determinant of thermal stability rankings, providing further insight into the complex chemistry of thermal decomposition. The differential learning framework generalizes across model architectures, from graph neural networks to classical descriptor-based approaches. Our results demonstrate that learning relative properties rather than absolute values offers a practical solution for modeling noisy experimental data, with direct applications in materials design where thermal stability predictions inform safety protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种差分学习框架来预测含能材料的热稳定性，通过训练消息传递神经网络预测分子间的相对差异而非绝对分解温度，在异构数据集上实现了超过85%的排序准确率，并识别出键解离焓是热稳定性排序的关键决定因素。
AI.motivation: 实验测量热稳定性在不同实验室间存在显著差异，由于协议和分析方法的不同，导致难以训练可靠的预测模型。传统的绝对温度预测方法对系统性实验误差敏感。
AI.method: 采用差分学习方法，训练消息传递神经网络预测分子对之间的相对差异，而非绝对分解温度。同时将神经网络模型与基于从头算计算和化学信息学软件描述符的可解释模型进行比较分析。
AI.result: 差分学习方法在化合物热稳定性排序上达到超过85%的准确率，优于在相同异构数据集上的传统回归方法；该框架可泛化到多种模型架构（图神经网络和经典描述符方法），并识别出键解离焓是热稳定性排序的关键决定因素。
AI.conclusion: 学习相对性质而非绝对值为含噪声实验数据的建模提供了实用解决方案，可直接应用于材料设计中热稳定性预测指导安全规程的场景。

title: Nonequilibrium pulse dynamics and metastable latching in nonlinear kinetic inductance detectors
summary: Microwave kinetic inductance detectors are typically operated at high readout power to raise the detector signal above system noise. At sufficiently large readout power, the current-dependent kinetic inductance couples the detector response to its readout bias. Using a nonlinear resonator framework and time-domain circuit calculations, we show that the amplitude, shape, and relaxation time of the driven detector's response depend on both the absorbed energy and on the readout bias. Strongly driven bias points produce amplified, extended, and non-exponential pulse responses. Qualitative agreement between calculated and measured pulse responses indicates that these effects are dominated by the driven nonlinear resonator dynamics rather than by altered quasiparticle dynamics. Beyond resonance bifurcation, sufficiently large pulse events drive the resonator between stable branches, resulting in a metastable latched state which persists after the quasiparticle transient has decayed. The pulse energy required for branch switching is set by the readout bias, suggesting a mode of triggered detection with an in-situ tunable threshold. Although nonlinear operation requires calibration of the bias- and energy-dependent response, the enhanced pulse amplitude and duration, together with tunable latching and the ability to select these parameters via the readout operating state, are likely to be of interest for single-photon and rare-event experiments, especially those limited by amplifier or system noise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了微波动力学电感探测器(MKID)在高读出功率下的非线性工作行为。研究表明，驱动非线性谐振器动力学主导了探测器的脉冲响应，强驱动偏置点会产生放大、延长且非指数的脉冲响应，并可在共振分岔边界上实现可原位调节阈值的触发式锁存检测模式。
AI.motivation: MKID通常在高温读功率下工作以提升信噪比，但在足够大的读出功率下，电流相关的动力学电感会使探测器响应与读出偏置耦合，导致传统线性模型失效。因此需要理解并表征高功率下的非线性动力学行为，以正确解释和分析探测器脉冲响应。
AI.method: 采用非线性谐振器框架和时域电路计算，对强驱动下的MKID响应进行建模。通过理论计算与实验测量的脉冲响应进行定性对比，验证效应主要由驱动非线性谐振器动力学主导，而非准粒子动力学的改变。分析共振分岔行为以及脉冲事件导致的稳定分支切换和锁存态。
AI.result: 强驱动偏置点产生放大、延长且非指数的脉冲响应；计算与测量的脉冲响应定性一致，表明效应由驱动非线性谐振器动力学主导。足够大的脉冲事件可跨越共振分岔，驱动谐振器在稳定分支间切换，形成在准粒子瞬态衰减后仍持续存在的亚稳态锁存态。分支切换所需的脉冲能量由读出偏置设定，可实现原位可调阈值的触发检测。
AI.conclusion: 虽然非线性工作需要对偏置和能量相关的响应进行校准，但增强的脉冲幅度和持续时间、可调锁存能力以及通过读出工作状态选择这些参数的能力，使该模式对单光子和稀有事件实验（尤其是受放大器或系统噪声限制的应用）具有重要价值。

title: Scattering-Induced Magnon Layer-Hall Transport beyond Band Geometry
summary: The layer Hall effect has been exclusively attributed to layer-locked Berry curvature, posing a fundamental barrier to its realization in conventional magnets. Here we report a fundamentally distinct layer Hall effect for bosonic excitations, i.e., magnons, which originates solely from non-reciprocal dipolar scattering at heterointerfaces, thereby decoupling the phenomenon from geometric-phase mechanisms. Using a microscopic scattering theory, we demonstrate that a longitudinal temperature gradient drives opposite transverse thermal Hall currents in a nanowire atop a magnetic film, with the direction fully reconfigurable by the applied magnetic field. The effect yields a significant Hall angle of $\sim 6^{\circ}$ in conventional magnetic heterostructures, eliminating the need for topological engineering. Our findings establish a scattering-driven paradigm for layer Hall effect, extendable to ferrons and polar phonons, and predict a Hall response that is readily detectable in conventional magnetic heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种全新的层霍尔效应机制，该效应源于磁性异质界面处的非互易偶极散射，而非传统的层锁定贝里曲率。研究证明，纵向温度梯度可在磁性薄膜上的纳米线中驱动方向相反的横向热霍尔电流，其方向可通过外加磁场完全重构，霍尔角可达约6°，无需拓扑工程。
AI.motivation: 传统的层霍尔效应被完全归因于层锁定的贝里曲率，这为在常规磁体中实现该效应设置了根本性障碍。作者希望打破这一限制，探索一种不依赖几何相机制的全新层霍尔效应实现途径。
AI.method: 采用微观散射理论，研究了磁性异质界面处磁振子的非互易偶极散射行为。通过分析纵向温度梯度驱动下的横向热输运，计算了纳米线结构中产生的反向热霍尔电流及其霍尔角。
AI.result: 在常规磁性异质结构中实现了约6°的显著霍尔角，该效应完全源于散射机制而非贝里曲率，方向可由外加磁场灵活调控，且在常规磁性异质结构中易于实验探测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了基于散射驱动的层霍尔效应新范式，可推广至铁振子和极性声子等玻色激发，为层霍尔效应研究开辟了不依赖拓扑工程的崭新途径，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Raman Circular Dichroism Reveals Higher-Order Quantum Geometry of Magnons
summary: We develop a gauge-invariant theory of higher-order magnon quantum geometry probed by two-magnon Raman circular dichroism (RCD). The Raman operator decomposes into Berry connections, covariant derivatives, and products of Berry connections, giving rise to quantum geometric tensors beyond the quantum metric and Berry curvature. Applying this theory to a field-polarized Kitaev magnet, we show that higher-order geometric tensors govern the dichroic response. Our results establish RCD as a spectroscopic probe of generalized magnon quantum geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一种规范不变的更高阶磁振子量子几何理论，用于探测双磁振子拉曼圆二色性（RCD），并将其应用于场极化Kitaev磁体，证明高阶几何张量决定二色响应，确立了RCD作为广义磁振子量子几何的光谱探针。
AI.motivation: 量子几何（量子度规和Berry曲率）在凝聚态物理中具有基础重要性，但传统研究主要集中于最低阶几何张量。有必要探索更高阶的量子几何张量及其可观测效应，以拓展对磁振子量子几何的理解。
AI.method: 发展规范不变的拉曼散射理论，将拉曼算符分解为Berry联络、协变导数及Berry联络的乘积，从而自然地引入超越量子度规和Berry曲率的量子几何张量。将该理论应用于场极化Kitaev磁体来检验高阶几何张量的物理效应。
AI.result: 研究表明，在场极化Kitaev磁体中，更高阶的量子几何张量主导了双磁振子拉曼圆二色响应，说明高阶几何效应具有可观测的物理后果。
AI.conclusion: RCD被确立为探测广义（更高阶）磁振子量子几何的光谱学工具，为量子几何的更高阶结构提供了实验可检验的途径。

title: Jamming states in random sequential adsorption of diffusion-limited aggregates
summary: Motivated by the ubiquity of ramified fractal deposits in nature and engineered systems, we investigate the irreversible adsorption of diffusion-limited aggregation (DLA) clusters on a square lattice. We study the role of cluster shape diversity on jamming properties of the system by systematically controlling the number of distinct shapes used across and within realizations, encompassing both monodisperse and polydisperse model variants. Our large-scale simulations over a broad range of cluster sizes $2\leqslant k\leqslant4096$ show that the jamming density decreases with cluster size as a power-law $p_j(k)-p_j^\infty\sim k^{-α}$. Both $α$ and $p_j^\infty$ are found to depend on the degree of shape diversity, with $α$ ranging from $0.374(2)$ to $0.417(1)$. It is observed that increasing shape polydispersity promotes denser packing. Importantly, the fluctuations of the jamming density exhibit distinct scaling behavior: $σ(L)\sim1/L$ for a fixed pool of cluster shape(s), but remain $L$-independent when the pool of shape(s) is refreshed across different realizations. Furthermore, our results demonstrate that the differences between the model variants systematically diminish with increasing $k$ and are expected to vanish as $k\to\infty$ due to the statistical self-similarity of the DLA clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了扩散限制聚集（DLA）簇在方格上的不可逆吸附，探讨簇形状多样性对堵塞性质的影响。通过控制不同形状簇的数量（从单分散到多分散），大规模模拟表明堵塞密度随簇尺寸呈幂律衰减，且指数α和极限堵塞密度均依赖形状多样性程度。更高的形状多分散性促进更致密的堆积，而堵塞密度的涨落表现出两种不同的标度行为，这取决于形状池是否在多次实验中刷新。
AI.motivation: 自然界和工程系统中普遍存在分形沉积物（如DLA簇），理解其不可逆吸附和堵塞行为对许多实际过程至关重要。以往研究多关注单一形状的吸附，而实际系统中簇的形状是高度多样化的，形状多样性对堵塞性质的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 在方格上模拟DLA簇的不可逆吸附，通过系统控制每次实验及实验间使用的不同形状数量（覆盖单分散与多分散变体），在簇尺寸k=2到4096的广泛范围内进行大规模模拟，分析堵塞密度、其标度行为及涨落特性。
AI.result: 堵塞密度随簇尺寸按幂律 p_j(k)-p_j^∞ ~ k^{-α} 衰减，α从0.374(2)到0.417(1)变化；α和p_j^∞都依赖于形状多样性程度。增加形状多分散性导致更致密的堆积。涨落标度方面：固定形状池时σ(L)~1/L，刷新形状池时涨落与L无关。不同模型变体间的差异随k增大而减小，预计在k→∞时消失。
AI.conclusion: 形状多样性显著影响DLA簇吸附的堵塞性质，但该影响随簇尺寸增大而逐渐减弱，最终因DLA簇的统计自相似性而在k→∞极限下消失。这表明小尺寸范围内形状多样性是堵塞行为的关键因素，而对大尺寸系统可采用简化的单分散模型近似。

title: Learning the Kohn-Sham map with neural operators for quasi-linear scaling density functional theory
summary: Kohn--Sham density functional theory (DFT) underpins electronic-structure simulations, but repeated orbital diagonalizations lead to cubic scaling, restricting quantum calculations to modest scales only. Eliminating these auxiliary orbitals while retaining Kohn--Sham accuracy is the central goal of orbital-free DFT, but both analytical and machine-learning methods have so far fallen short. Prior learning approaches either try to learn the variational kinetic-energy functionals, which are ill-conditioned, or directly predict the ground state, which extrapolate poorly to larger systems. Instead, we identify the Kohn--Sham map as the right learning target for orbital-free DFT. It maps a Kohn--Sham potential directly to the corresponding density and noninteracting kinetic energy, quantities otherwise obtained through an orbital diagonalization. Focusing on the density component in this work, a domain-invariant $\mathrm{SE}(3)$-equivariant Fourier neural operator learns to predict it from the potential as input on real-space grids, enabling stable quasi-linear scaling SCFs. Trained jointly on 8,504 molecules and solids, a single model generalizes to out-of-distribution organic molecules, insulators, and metals. For the first time, the same method converges SCFs across these systems without explicitly constructing Kohn--Sham orbitals, while reproducing densities, electronic spectra, and structural observables at Kohn--Sham DFT accuracy. Linear-scaling SCFs additionally allow converging magnesium dislocation densities containing up to 82,500 valence electrons on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将Kohn-Sham映射（从KS势到电子密度和非相互作用动能）作为无轨道DFT的学习目标，使用域不变的SE(3)等变傅里叶神经算子直接从势预测密度，实现准线性标度的自洽场（SCF）计算，跨越分子、绝缘体和金属等多种体系，并首次无需显式构造KS轨道即可收敛SCF，同时达到KS-DFT精度。
AI.motivation: 传统KS-DFT因反复轨道对角化导致立方标度，限制了量子计算规模；无轨道DFT旨在消除辅助轨道但保留KS精度，然而先前的解析方法和机器学习方法均未成功——学习变分动能泛函是病态的，直接预测基态则外推性差。因此需要寻找正确的学习目标。
AI.method: 将Kohn-Sham映射（KS势→密度和非相互作用动能）作为学习目标，替代传统的轨道对角化步骤。本文聚焦密度分量，采用域不变（domain-invariant）的SE(3)等变傅里叶神经算子，在实空间网格上以KS势为输入预测电子密度，从而实现稳定的准线性标度SCF。
AI.result: 在8,504个分子和固体上联合训练，单一模型能够泛化到分布外的有机分子、绝缘体和金属。首次在不显式构造KS轨道的情况下收敛这些体系的SCF，同时以KS-DFT精度重现密度、电子谱和结构观测量。线性标度SCF还能够在单个GPU上收敛含82,500个价电子的镁位错密度。
AI.conclusion: Kohn-Sham映射是比动能泛函学习或基态直接预测更好的无轨道DFT学习目标，SE(3)等变傅里叶神经算子配合域不变训练策略可同时实现精度与可扩展性，为大规模电子结构计算开辟了新路径。

title: Phase-controlled perfect nonlocal spin and charge diode effects in a four-terminal Josephson junction with $p$-wave magnets
summary: We theoretically investigate charge and spin transport in a four-terminal Josephson junction with a normal-metal barrier. The top and bottom superconducting leads are equal-spin triplet $p_y$-wave superconductors, while the left and right leads are $p$-wave magnets with proximity-induced conventional $s$-wave superconductivity. When the transverse macroscopic phase difference between the top and bottom leads is set to zero, a longitudinal phase bias generates a pure transverse spin current with perfect 100% nonreciprocity. Remarkably, a finite transverse phase difference preserves the perfect spin-diode effect while simultaneously inducing a perfect charge-diode effect, enabling fully nonreciprocal spin and charge transport. Moreover, the spin-diode efficiency exhibits sharp, step-like switching as a function of both the gate voltage applied to the barrier and the crystallographic orientation of the $p$-wave magnet, providing independent and experimentally accessible knobs for controlling the diode polarity. The diode response remains robust against asymmetric interface couplings, nonmagnetic disorder, variations in the relative singlet and triplet pairing strengths, temperature, and junction dimensions, demonstrating that the effect is not a consequence of fine-tuned parameters. These findings establish the proposed four-terminal junction as a highly tunable and structurally robust platform for dissipationless, phase-controlled spin and charge rectification, with potential applications in superconducting spintronics.

title: Composite fermions in the $ν=3$ fractional quantum spin Hall effect
summary: Well-understood fractional quantum Hall states in GaAs and graphene can be described in terms of weakly interacting composite fermions. It is natural to expect that the same unifying principle applies to the putative fractional quantum spin Hall effect in MoTe$_2$. Since the quantum spin Hall effect involves two spin components, two types of composite fermions must be present. We classify all two-component composite-fermion states at the filling factor $ν=3$. The classification includes the three classes of states, which were introduced from different physical perspectives in Refs. Sodemann Villadiego, Phys. Rev. B 110, 045114 (2024), Jian et al., Phys. Rev. X 15, 021063 (2025), and May-Mann et al., Phys. Rev. B 111, L201111, (2025), as well as two new classes of states. A majority of the composite-fermion states break the time-reversal symmetry. We review quasiparticle charges, statistics, and edge theories for each possible state. We also address a way of identifying the experimentally relevant state or states. This can be accomplished by combining three probes. First, the shot noise technique provides information about fractional charges. Second, thermal conductance helps count edge modes. The third probe is based on a new idea and involves transport between two quantum point contacts along a single edge. We find that the current from one contact to the other depends on the shape of the edge channel, which can be controlled with a side gate. The probe reveals the emergent symmetry group of the low-energy edge theory.

title: Reality and Complexity of $F$-symbols in $2+1$d Topological Phases
summary: The $F$-symbols of an anyon theory encode the associativity of fusion and constitute some of the theory's most fundamental and, simultaneously, subtle data. Much of the subtlety lies in the gauge-dependence of the $F$-symbols. Despite their generic complexity, many braided anyon theories admit gauges in which all $F$-symbols are real, a phenomenon for which no general organising principle has been known. We identify a physical mechanism underlying this reality. For a unitary ribbon fusion category admitting an appropriate braided charge-conjugation symmetry, we show that the complex-conjugated $F$-symbols are related to the original ones by a gauge transformation. Finding a real gauge is thereby reduced to a condition on these transformations. When the charge-conjugation symmetry is suitably "flat,'' or equivalently when the associated "twisted'' Frobenius-Schur (or "generalized'' Kawanaka-Matsuyama) data respects a grading, these local transformations can be trivialised and a real gauge exists. This framework unifies a broad range of previously disparate examples, including families of Chern-Simons theories whose $F$-symbols are difficult to directly compute. Finally, we exhibit a unitary ribbon category that realizes a novel obstruction to the existence of a real gauge and therefore has inherently complex $F$-symbols.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了任意子理论中F符号取实数的物理机制。作者证明，对于具有适当braided电荷-共轭对称性的酉ribbon融合范畴，复共轭的F符号与原F符号之间可通过规范变换建立联系。当电荷-共轭对称性满足特定"平坦"条件（即相关的"扭曲"Frobenius-Schur数据尊重分级结构）时，这些局域变换可被平凡化，从而存在实规范。该框架统一了包括Chern-Simons理论在内的大量此前看似不相关的例子，并构造了一个具有本质复F符号的新型酉ribbon范畴。
AI.motivation: F符号编码任意子理论中融合的结合性，是该理论最基础但又最微妙的数据之一，其微妙性在于规范依赖性。尽管许多braided任意子理论都存在所有F符号为实数的规范，但此前对这一现象缺乏一般性的组织原理。论文旨在找出F符号可取实的物理机制。
AI.method: 论文采用范畴论的数学框架。对于具有braided电荷-共轭对称性的酉ribbon融合范畴，证明复共轭F符号与原F符号之间由规范变换联系。通过分析这些变换在"平坦"条件（即扭曲Frobenius-Schur数据尊重分级）下可平凡化，从而建立实规范存在的条件。

title: Spectrally Programmable Spin-Polarized Photocurrents in WSe$_2$-NiPS$_3$ Magnetic van der Waals Heterostructures
summary: Efficient generation and control of spin-polarized currents in semiconductors remain central challenges for spin-based electronics, particularly due to impedance mismatch and the reliance on magnetic fields or ferromagnetic contacts. Here, we introduce a materials platform for spectrally programmable spin transport based on a van der Waals heterostructure combining the antiferromagnetic semiconductor NiPS$_3$ with WSe$_2$. In a p-n diode architecture, circularly polarized excitation produces pronounced photoconductive resonances with spin polarization reaching 80% near the Neel temperature and persisting at 30% at room temperature. Remarkably, selected spectral bands retain their polarization sign across the magnetic phase transition, evidencing robust, spectrally protected spin-polarized current generation. Polarization-resolved photogalvanic measurements reveal a dominant circular injection-current mechanism, confirming spin-polarized carrier transport. First-principles calculations show that an applied electric field induces interfacial hybridization and spin-layer locking, giving rise to localized symmetry breaking and enhanced optical absorption while preserving global time-reversal symmetry. These results establish spectral tuning of excitation as a new control knob for spin transport, enabling spin-current generation without magnetic fields or polarization switching. Our findings position magnetic van der Waals heterostructures as a versatile platform for opto-spintronic functionality and spectrally programmable spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于NiPS₃/WSe₂范德华异质结的材料平台，通过圆偏振光激发在p-n二极管结构中实现光谱可编程的自旋输运，自旋极化率在尼尔温度附近达80%，室温仍保持30%，且无需磁场或铁磁接触即可产生自旋极化电流。

title: Bulk Phase Transition and Edge Behavior in Temporally Correlated Random Matrices
summary: We study long-range correlated Wigner-type matrices built from row-independent stationary Gaussian sequences. For exponentially decaying (AR(1)) correlations, the bulk spectral density deforms from the semicircle law via an explicit combinatorial "hub" mechanism, yet we verify the flatness and decay hypotheses of the matrix-Dyson-equation framework (MDE), with numerical evidence supporting Tracy-Widom edge universality for every fixed $ρ<1$ of the exponential decay correlations; the degenerate limit $ρ\to1^-$ reduces to a symmetrized Volterra operator, connecting to the singular-value cascade identified in a companion BBP analysis. For power-law correlations $dt\sim t^{-γ}$, we identify $γ_c=1/2$ as the critical point for divergence of the bulk fourth-moment, while $γ=1$ marks the breakdown of the flatness condition governing the MDE edge analysis. We prove the fourth-moment transition exactly and find numerically that the self-consistent edge varies smoothly across $γ=1$, with no evidence of a kink or discontinuity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了由行独立平稳高斯序列构建的长程相关Wigner型矩阵。对于指数衰减（AR(1)）相关，体谱密度通过显式组合"枢纽"机制从半圆律变形，同时验证了矩阵Dyson方程（MDE）框架的平坦性和衰减假设，数值证据支持每个固定ρ<1下的Tracy-Widom边缘普适性；退化极限ρ→1⁻简化为对称化Volterra算子。对于幂律相关dt∼t^{-γ}，识别出γ_c=1/2作为体四阶矩发散的关键点，γ=1标志着MDE边缘分析中平坦性条件的失效。论文精确证明了四阶矩转变，并数值发现自洽边缘在γ=1处平滑变化，无扭结或间断。
AI.motivation: 理解长程相关随机矩阵的谱性质，特别是相关结构如何影响体密度和边缘普适性，以及识别MDE框架适用的边界条件。
AI.method: 采用组合分析（"枢纽"机制）、矩阵Dyson方程（MDE）框架、数值模拟以及正则化极限分析（Volterra算子）相结合的方法。
AI.result: 1) 对AR(1)指数衰减相关，验证了MDE框架的平坦性和衰减假设，数值支持Tracy-Widom边缘普适性；2) 对幂律相关，确定γ_c=1/2为四阶矩发散临界点，γ=1为平坦性失效点；3) 精确证明四阶矩转变，数值表明边缘在γ=1处平滑变化。

title: Quantum Vibronic Dynamics Shape Catalytically Relevant Au-Ligand Interfaces in Atomically Precise Gold Nanoclusters
summary: Atomically precise gold nanoclusters are versatile for photocatalysis and energy conversion because their electronic structure stems from strong metal-ligand interactions. However, these interactions are mostly discussed statically, leaving dynamic reorganization of Au-ligand interfaces under photoexcitation unclear. We investigate rod-shaped [Au25(PPh3)10(SC2H5)5Cl2]2+ using ultrafast transient-grating spectroscopy, two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy, ab initio calculations, and hierarchical equations-of-motion simulations. The multidimensional spectra resolve multiple electronic relaxation pathways and a hierarchy of coherent structural motions, from localized Au-ligand distortions to collective framework vibrations. Wavelet analysis reveals that high-frequency Au-ligand vibrations emerge immediately after excitation, whereas low-frequency collective modes appear later through interstate vibronic coupling, indicating sequential redistribution of structural coherence. Simulations reproduce the nonlinear response and identify the microscopic vibronic couplings responsible. The results show that photoexcitation drives continuous ultrafast reorganization of the Au-ligand bonding network, transiently reshaping interfacial electronic structure before thermalization. This work establishes dynamic Au-ligand interfaces as the microscopic link between excited-state energy flow and photochemical function in atomically precise nanoclusters.

AI.tldr: 本文利用超快瞬态光栅光谱、二维电子光谱、从头计算和分级运动方程模拟，揭示了原子级精确金纳米团簇[Au25(PPh3)10(SC2H5)5Cl2]2+在光激发下Au-配体界面发生连续的动态重构过程。多维光谱分辨出多种电子弛豫路径和从局域Au-配体畸变到集体框架振动的多层级相干结构运动，证明光激发驱动Au-配体键合网络发生持续的亚皮秒级重新组织，在热化前瞬态重塑界面电子结构。

AI.result: 多维光谱分辨出多条电子弛豫路径和多层级相干结构运动；高频Au-配体振动在激发后立即出现，而低频集体模式通过态间振动耦合稍后出现，呈现结构相干性的顺序再分布；模拟成功重现非线性响应并鉴定出微观振动耦合机制。

title: Josephson effect in bipolar magnetic semiconductors
comment: 6 pages, 5 captioned figures. Comments are welcome
summary: We theoretically investigate equilibrium currents in a one-dimensional Josephson junction incorporating a bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS). We show that the intrinsic exchange splitting of the spin-resolved bands enables purely electrical control of the $0$--$π$ transition through gate-tunable modulation of the BMS chemical potential, eliminating the need for an external magnetic field. This provides a viable route toward electrically tunable $π$-junction behavior and highlights the potential of BMS-based Josephson devices for phase-controllable superconducting electronics. Furthermore, in the presence of Rashba spin--orbit coupling, we find an anomalous Josephson effect characterized by a finite equilibrium supercurrent at zero phase difference. This behavior originates from the intrinsic breaking of time-reversal symmetry associated with the spin-polarized electronic structure of the BMS. Interestingly, despite the simultaneous breaking of time-reversal and inversion symmetries---conditions often associated with nonreciprocal superconducting transport---we do not observe a Josephson diode effect. Our results therefore highlight an important distinction between anomalous Josephson transport and superconducting nonreciprocity: the former does not necessarily imply a finite critical-current asymmetry between opposite current directions.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了一维约瑟夫森结中嵌入双极磁性半导体（BMS）的平衡电流，发现BMS的自旋分辨能带内禀交换劈裂可实现纯电学调控的0-π跃迁，无需外加磁场；在 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合下出现零相位差下的有限平衡超流（反常约瑟夫森效应），但尽管时间反演和反演对称性同时破缺，却未观察到约瑟夫森二极管效应。
AI.motivation: 现有π结和反常约瑟夫森效应的实现通常依赖外加磁场或复杂的磁性结构，作者希望探索一种无需外磁场、通过纯电学手段调控约瑟夫森结相行为的方案。BMS的内禀交换劈裂特性为这一目标提供了天然的平台，同时研究其与自旋轨道耦合协同作用下的新奇输运现象。
AI.method: 采用理论分析方法，在一维约瑟夫森结模型中引入BMS作为中间层，通过门电压调控BMS化学势来调制自旋分辨能带的填充，从而控制0-π跃迁。同时引入Rashba自旋轨道耦合，在平衡态下计算超电流与相位差的关系，分析反常约瑟夫森效应及约瑟夫森二极管效应的存在性。
AI.result: 发现BMS的交换劈裂使0-π跃迁可通过门电压纯电学调控；在Rashba自旋轨道耦合下，观察到零相位差时的有限平衡超流（φ0约瑟夫森结），证明时间反演对称性破缺源于BMS的自旋极化电子结构。然而，尽管时间和反演对称性同时破缺，并未出现约瑟夫森二极管效应，说明正反方向临界电流仍然对称。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了BMS基约瑟夫森器件在可调π结和相位可控超导电子学中的应用潜力，并强调了反常约瑟夫森输运与超导非互易性之间的重要区别——前者并不必然意味着临界电流的不对称。

title: Weaving Hopfions from Emergent Monopoles in a Chiral Magnet
summary: Recent advances in three-dimensional magnetization imaging techniques have opened new avenues for exploring topological spin textures beyond domain walls and skyrmions. Among them, magnetic hopfions are particularly promising, as their knotted topology is expected to give rise to unconventional dynamics and responses; however, their controlled creation remains challenging. Here we propose a simple mechanism for generating hopfions from magnetic torons, three-dimensional textures hosting an emergent monopole-antimonopole pair. Using Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations, we show that an electric current drives the annihilation of this pair, converting a toron into a hopfion. The initial toron length determines the number of generated hopfions, while the current direction selects the sign of the Hopf invariant. We further find that the threshold current depends sensitively on material parameters, indicating a close connection to skyrmion dynamics. Our results establish an experimentally accessible route to hopfion creation and reveal a pathway from monopole defects to knotted topological textures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过电流驱动磁拓扑子（toron）中的单极-反单极对湮灭来生成磁霍普夫子（hopfion）的简单机制。通过Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert模拟表明，初始toron长度决定生成hopfion的数量，电流方向决定Hopf不变量的符号，为hopfion的实验制备提供了可行途径。
AI.motivation: 磁霍普夫子因其纽结拓扑结构有望产生非常规动力学和响应特性，但可控地创建hopfion一直是挑战，需要建立从三维拓扑自旋结构到hopfion的生成机制。
AI.method: 提出利用电流驱动磁toron中的单极-反单极对湮灭来生成hopfion；使用Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert模拟进行验证；系统研究初始toron长度、电流方向和材料参数对hopfion生成的影响。
AI.result: 电流能有效驱动单极-反单极对湮灭，将toron转化为hopfion；生成hopfion的数量由初始toron长度决定，Hopf不变量符号由电流方向选择；阈值电流对材料参数敏感，与skyrmion动力学密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了从磁toron到hopfion的可行实验路径，揭示了从单极缺陷到纽结拓扑结构的转化机制，为hopfion的实验创建和进一步研究奠定了基础。

title: Quantum-geometry stabilization of dilute fractional Chern insulators
summary:
Fractional Chern insulators have attracted broad interest as lattice analogs of fractional quantum Hall states without Landau levels. However, low-filling fractional Chern insulators are fragile because charge-ordered phases can compete strongly with the fractional topological liquid.
  Here, we propose a center-decorated kagome model, motivated by geometry-tunable artificial lattices, in which the center-site hopping $t_2$ provides a direct knob for the quantum geometry of an isolated $C=1$ flat band.
  Here quantum geometry refers to the Berry curvature and Fubini--Study metric, which determine the form factors of interactions projected into the Chern band. Exact diagonalization shows that tuning $t_2$ away from the flatness-optimized kagome limit reduces the trace-condition deviation, suppresses competing charge order, and enhances the many-body stability at both $ν=1/3$ and the more fragile $ν=1/5$ filling.
  At $ν=1/5$, this stability-enhanced window persists under nearby interaction profiles, including variations of the dominant third-neighbor repulsion and weak nearest-neighbor admixtures.
  Low-energy spectra, spectral flow, quasihole and entanglement counting, static structure factors, and the quantized total many-body Chern number $C_{\mathrm{tot}}=1$ consistently support Laughlin-like fractional Chern insulators.
  These results identify quantum-geometry engineering as a route to stabilizing dilute fractional Chern insulators beyond band-flatness optimization alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种中心修饰的Kagome晶格模型，通过调控中心位点跳跃参数t₂来优化Chern带的量子几何性质（Berry曲率和Fubini-Study度规），从而抑制电荷有序竞争，增强低填充分数Chern绝缘体（ν=1/3和ν=1/5）的多体稳定性，并通过精确对角化验证了Laughlin类分数Chern绝缘体态的存在。
AI.motivation: 低填充分数Chern绝缘体很脆弱，因为电荷有序相会与分数拓扑液体强烈竞争。已有的研究大多关注平带平坦度优化，但对于如何在低填充下稳定分数Chern绝缘体仍然缺乏有效策略。
AI.method: 提出中心修饰的Kagome模型，利用中心位点跳跃t₂作为调控量子几何（Berry曲率与Fubini-Study度规）的直接旋钮，并通过精确对角化研究ν=1/3和ν=1/5填充下的多体稳定性。
AI.result: 调节t₂偏离平带优化极限可减少trace-condition偏差，抑制电荷有序，增强ν=1/3和ν=1/5填充的稳定性。在ν=1/5下，该稳定窗口对邻近相互作用的变化具有鲁棒性。低能谱、谱流、准空穴与纠缠计数、静态结构因子以及C_tot=1的量子化Chern数均一致支持Laughlin类分数Chern绝缘体。
AI.conclusion: 量子几何工程是超越单纯平带平坦度优化、稳定稀薄分数Chern绝缘体的有效途径。

title: Engineering Dirac interface states
summary: We develop a low-energy theory of interface states in anisotropic multivalley Dirac systems whose masses and kinetic parameters are allowed to vary across an interface. For sharp interfaces, current-conserving matching conditions yield analytic expressions for the existence, localization and dispersion of the bound states. We show that the interface velocity is determined by the weighted tangential kinetic terms on the two sides of the seam. Their cancellation can suppress the linear velocity and generate an interface band that is flat to leading order near the projected Dirac point. For the special antisymmetric configuration in which both the Dirac mass and the tangential kinetic coefficient reverse sign with unchanged magnitude, the transparent sharp-interface solution is exactly dispersionless for all conserved momenta within the linear Dirac theory, while the surrounding bulk bands remain dispersive. We extend the theory to smooth interfaces, where the modified bound-state envelope changes the linear interface velocity through a spatial average of the tangential kinetic coefficient. We also investigate quadratic corrections in the kinetic \(σ_x\) and \(σ_y\) channels. To first order in their coefficients and through linear order in the interface momentum, these terms shift the interface-state energy but produce no additional correction to the linear velocity. Finally, we combine continuum and lattice models to show how interface modes from distinct valleys hybridize and how the resulting dispersions depend on microscopic interface properties. Our results establish design principles for controlling the dispersion, localization, and hybridization of Dirac interface states. We further examine two graphene-based mass-domain-wall models as experimentally inspired examples of dispersive copropagating and counterpropagating interface states.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一个用于各向异性多谷狄拉克系统中界面态的低能理论。作者推导了尖锐界面下束缚态的存在性、局域化和色散的解析表达式，并发现界面速度由界面两侧的切向动能项决定。特别地，在反对称构型下可获得完全无色散的界面平带。理论还扩展到光滑界面、动力学二次修正、谷间杂化等情形，最终给出了石墨烯质量畴壁模型作为实验示例。
AI.motivation: 理解并控制多谷狄拉克系统中的界面态色散关系，建立设计原则以调控界面态的传播速度、局域化和谷间杂化行为。
AI.method: 采用低能有效理论，对尖锐界面使用电流守恒的匹配条件推导束缚态解析解；将尖锐界面理论推广到光滑界面（通过空间平均切向动能系数）；考虑动能σ_x和σ_y通道的二次修正；结合连续模型和格点模型研究谷间杂化。
AI.result: (1) 尖锐界面下界面速度由两侧加权的切向动能项决定，其相互抵消可产生完全平带；(2) 在反对称构型（质量与切向动能系数同时变号且幅值不变）下，透明尖锐界面解在所有守恒动量下精确无色散，而体带仍有色散；(3) 光滑界面通过切向动能系数的空间平均修正界面速度；(4) 二次修正项只移动界面态能量但不改变线性速度；(5) 两种石墨烯质量畴壁模型（共传播与反向传播界面态）作为实验示例被分析。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了控制狄拉克界面态色散、局域化和杂化的设计原则，可为基于界面态的新型电子器件和拓扑物态设计提供理论指导。

title: Geometric Thermodynamics of Scallop Motion with Two Control Parameters
comment: 24 pages (14 pages for the main text), 6 figures
summary: According to Purcell's scallop theorem, reciprocal single-degree-of-freedom shape deformations cannot achieve net propulsion in a viscous fluid. We show that this limitation is bypassed by thermal fluctuations in a two-parameter driven potential landscape. Formulating the stochastic shape dynamics via a Smoluchowski equation with position-dependent mobility $M_\mathrm{eff}(x)$, we utilize a generalized inverse operator to evaluate the slow-driving response. Cyclic modulation of the control parameters induces a non-zero Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman curvature $F_{12}(\bmθ)$, resulting in directed geometric propulsion. Simultaneously, the non-adiabatic excess dissipation is dictated by a Riemannian thermodynamic metric $g_{ij}(\bmθ)$. Our results provide a unified geometric foundation that bridges hydrodynamic friction, stochastic mechanics, and thermodynamic trade-offs in micro-swimmers.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，通过热涨落和双参数驱动势能景观，可以绕过Purcell的扇贝定理，实现粘性流体中的净推进。利用Smoluchowski方程和广义逆算子，作者揭示了循环参数调控产生的Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率可导致定向几何推进，同时非绝热过剩耗散由黎曼热力学度量决定，为微游泳者的水动力摩擦、随机力学和热力学权衡提供了统一的几何基础。
AI.motivation: 根据Purcell扇贝定理，在粘性流体中，单自由度往复形状变形无法产生净推进。作者希望探索是否可以通过热涨落和更复杂的参数驱动机制来突破这一限制。
AI.method: 作者通过含位置依赖迁移率M_eff(x)的Smoluchowski方程描述随机形状动力学，利用广义逆算子评估慢驱动响应，并计算循环参数调制下的Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率F_12(θ)和黎曼热力学度量g_ij(θ)。
AI.result: 循环调控控制参数产生非零的Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率，诱导定向几何推进，同时非绝热过剩耗散由黎曼热力学度量控制，揭示了水动力摩擦、随机力学和热力学之间的内在联系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为微游泳者提供了一个统一的几何框架，将水动力摩擦、随机力学和热力学权衡联系起来，从理论上证明了热涨落可以克服Purcell扇贝定理的限制。

title: Efficient, precise DFT calculations of NMR shieldings: Revisiting the finite field approach
summary: Absolute nuclear magnetic shielding constants and relative chemical shifts are second-derivative response properties that underpin the interpretation of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectra and provide critical insights into the structural and electronic environments of diverse chemical systems. However, their accurate computation is often constrained by the need for method-specific, analytical response implementation, and therefore is particularly challenging for non-variational, correlated wavefunction methods where analytical second derivatives are frequently unavailable. Here we present a scalable framework that computes NMR shielding tensors through finite magnetic field differentiation of complex-valued, gauge-including atomic-orbital (GIAO) based self-consistent field (SCF) calculations. By combining hybrid MPI and OpenMP parallelization and resolution-of-identity (RI) approximation-based Coulomb (J) and Exchange (K) implementation and mixed numerical/analytical derivatives computational scheme, we achieve very good efficiency for hybrid density functional theory (DFT) NMR shielding, relative to existing state-of-the-art analytic implementations across realistic chemical systems of various sizes. Forward differentiation with optimal step sizes derived from rigorous error analysis retains favorable numerical errors much smaller than experimental uncertainty or intrinsic DFT errors. The results demonstrate that RI-accelerated finite magnetic field calculations can obtain DFT-level NMR shielding constants very precisely, providing a scalable foundation for extensions to more advanced quantum chemistry methods in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过有限磁场微分计算NMR屏蔽张量的可扩展框架，基于复值GIAO的SCF计算，结合混合MPI/OpenMP并行化和RI近似，实现了高效且精确的杂化DFT NMR屏蔽计算。
AI.motivation: NMR屏蔽常数的精确计算通常需要方法特定的解析响应实现，对于非变分、相关波函数方法尤为困难，因为解析二阶导数往往不可用。因此需要一种可扩展且通用的替代方案。
AI.method: 通过有限磁场微分对复值GIAO基SCF计算进行数值求导；采用混合MPI和OpenMP并行化；利用RI近似加速Coulomb (J)和Exchange (K)项；采用数值/解析混合微分方案；通过严格误差分析确定最优步长。
AI.result: 该方法在杂化DFT NMR屏蔽计算中取得了与现有最先进解析实现相当的效率，跨越各种大小的真实化学体系。数值误差远小于实验不确定度或DFT本身的内在误差。
AI.conclusion: RI加速的有限磁场计算能够以很高的精度获得DFT级别的NMR屏蔽常数，为未来扩展到更先进的量子化学方法提供了可扩展的基础。

title: Disorder-tuned crossing of monopole and conventional pairing instabilities in multi-Weyl semimetals
summary: We study how non-magnetic impurity scattering affects the emergence and possible coexistence of pairing instabilities in a two-node multi-Weyl semimetal. Within an explicitly specified projected impurity kernel---valley diagonal and momentum independent across each Fermi pocket, the leading behaviour of non-magnetic disorder in the small-pocket window $q^{\max}_{\rm intra}ξ_{\rm dis}\ll1\ll|2\mathbf Q|ξ_{\rm dis}$, treated at leading order in Born and Abrikosov--Gor'kov theory---quenched disorder tunes the leading pairing instability from a topologically nontrivial monopole channel to a conventional ($s$-wave) one, extending our earlier clean-system analysis into the disordered regime. A Born self-energy calculation in the chiral band basis then gives: (i) a band-isotropic conventional channel that is Anderson protected against intra-node scalar disorder ($η_s=1$), introduced phenomenologically at the projected-band level; solving the competition for arbitrary $η_s$ yields the crossing criterion $(1-η_s)/(1-η_m)<T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}$, so the mechanism tolerates substantial loss of conventional-channel protection; and (ii) a rank-one monopole sector fixing $f_m$ as the exact eigenfunction with $η_m(J)=1/(J+2)$, exact given that kernel. The crossing location in $Γ_N/T_{c0}^{(m)}$ is set by $η_m(J)$, $η_s$, and $r=T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}$. From the clean projected BdG Hamiltonian the pure monopole nodes carry Berry charge $\pm J$, distinct from the gapped conventional solution; the clean nodal thermodynamics is charge-dependent, $N_{\rm SC}(E)\propto E^{2/J}$ and $C\propto T^{1+2/J}$, and the residual density of states shows a threshold only for $J=1$. The crossing lies in the moderately metallic regime, $μ/Γ_N\simeq11$--$14$ for the illustrative $T_{c0}^{(m)}/μ=0.133$ used in the figures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非磁性杂质散射对双节点多Weyl半金属中配对不稳定性的影响。在特定投影杂质核下，无序会通过Born和Abrikosov-Gor'kov理论将主导配对不稳定性从拓扑非平凡的单极子通道调谐到传统s波通道。研究发现s波通道具有Anderson保护性(η_s=1)，而单极子通道的η_m(J)=1/(J+2)。交叉判据为(1-η_s)/(1-η_m)<T_c0^(s)/T_c0^(m)。纯单极子节点携带Berry电荷±J，其热力学性质呈电荷依赖性(N_SC(E)∝E^(2/J), C∝T^(1+2/J))，且仅J=1时残余态密度存在阈值。
AI.motivation: 扩展作者此前关于无杂质多Weyl半金属配对不稳定性分析到无序区域，探究杂质散射如何影响和调控配对通道的涌现与共存。
AI.method: 在明确指定的投影杂质核(valley对角、跨费米口袋动量无关)框架下，采用Born近似和Abrikosov-Gor'kov理论的领头阶处理无序效应；利用手征能带基的Born自能计算分析常规s波通道和单极子通道的竞争。
AI.result: (i)获得带各向同性的常规通道，具有Anderson保护性(η_s=1)，交叉判据为(1-η_s)/(1-η_m)<T_c0^(s)/T_c0^(m)；(ii)单极子扇区秩为1，f_m为精确本征函数，η_m(J)=1/(J+2)。纯单极子节点携带Berry电荷±J，热力学为N_SC(E)∝E^(2/J)、C∝T^(1+2/J)，仅J=1有残余态密度阈值。交叉点位于中等金属区域(μ/Γ_N≈11-14)。
AI.conclusion: 无序可将多Weyl半金属的配对不稳定性从拓扑单极子通道调谐至传统s波通道，且该机制对常规通道保护的损失具有较强容忍度。其热力学性质依赖于节点Berry电荷，体现了拓扑与配对物理的深层联系。

title: Electronic cooling of a TiW alloy normal-metal island using Nb-based superconducting tunnel junctions
summary: TiW thin films remain non-superconducting down to millikelvin temperatures and are compatible with large-scale CMOS manufacturing, making them attractive for cryogenic and quantum tunnel-junction devices, such as normal-metal-insulator-superconductor (NIS) thermal sensors and electron refrigerators. We demonstrate significant electronic cooling of a TiW-based normal-metal island and electron thermometry by using TiW-Al-AlOx-Nb NIS tunnel-junction stacks. The NIS thermometer enables local electron temperature measurements from 0.5 to 8.32 K. NIS cooling is observed between 0.6 and 3.5 K, with maximum absolute and relative temperature reductions of 217 mK and 27%, respectively. Calculations using tunnel-junction parameters obtained independently from current-voltage fits reproduce the measured optimum-voltage scale, which lies substantially below the ideal low-temperature prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了TiW基NIS隧穿结在低温下的电子制冷与测温能力。TiW薄膜在毫开尔文温度下仍保持非超导态，且与CMOS工艺兼容。研究者利用TiW-Al-AlOx-Nb NIS隧穿结堆叠实现了对TiW正常金属岛的显著电子冷却和电子测温，测温范围为0.5-8.32K，制冷观测区间为0.6-3.5K，最大绝对温降217mK（相对降幅27%）。实验发现最优电压标度远低于理想低温预测值，而基于独立电流-电压拟合得到的隧穿结参数计算能复现该电压标度。
AI.motivation: TiW薄膜因其在毫开尔文温度下仍不超导且与大规模CMOS制造兼容的特性，非常适合用于低温及量子隧穿结器件（如NIS热传感器和电子制冷器）。然而此前缺乏基于TiW的NIS隧穿结在电子冷却和测温方面的实验验证，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 制备TiW-Al-AlOx-Nb NIS隧穿结堆叠结构，利用TiW作为正常金属岛，Nb作为超导电极。通过NIS结作为电子温度计在0.5-8.32K范围内进行局域电子温度测量，并利用同一结的制冷效应对TiW岛进行电子冷却，通过电流-电压特性拟合独立提取隧穿结参数以解释实验现象。
AI.result: 成功实现NIS测温（0.5-8.32K）和NIS制冷（0.6-3.5K区间），最大绝对温度降低217mK，相对降低27%。实验结果揭示了最优制冷电压远低于理想低温预测值，且该现象可被基于独立I-V拟合参数的模型准确复现。
AI.conclusion: TiW基NIS结可作为CMOS兼容的低温电子制冷与测温平台，其制冷性能虽受限于实际隧穿结参数（导致最优电压偏离理想值），但计算与实验的一致性验证了器件行为的可预测性，为大规模集成低温器件提供了可行材料路线。

title: Neutron scattering evidence for two-dimensionally coupled spin-dimerized antiferromagnetic lattice in α-Cu2P2O7
summary: The microscopic magnetic model of the low-dimensional quantum magnet alpha-Cu2P2O7 has remained controversial. We present a comprehensive study of its magnetic ground state and excitation spectrum using temperature-dependent inelastic neutron scattering, neutron diffraction, magnetization measurements, and comprehensive spin-wave modeling. Our results unambiguously establish alpha-Cu2P2O7 as a two-dimensionally coupled spin-dimerized antiferromagnetic (AF) lattice within the bc plane, with a dominant AF exchange J2 = 7.73 meV (hereafter referred to as "intradimer exchange") and weaker exchange couplings J1, J3, and J4 in the two-dimensional lattice (hereafter referred to as "interdimer exchange"), in agreement with LDA-based density functional theory and in contrast to previous GGA+U predictions. The dominant intradimer AF exchange is found between seventh-nearest-neighbor Cu-Cu ion pairs [d(Cu-Cu) = 5.125(3) A] rather than nearest-neighbor Cu-Cu ion pairs [d(Cu-Cu) = 3.014(1) A] of the structural dimers. Weak interlayer coupling (J5 = 0.03 meV) stabilizes long-range antiferromagnetic order below TN = 25 K. We further identify a weak single-ion anisotropy, associated with the distorted CuO5 polyhedra, that opens a gap in the spin-excitation spectrum and drives a field-induced metamagnetic transition. Systematic spin-wave calculations elucidate the distinct roles of interlayer coupling J5 and anisotropy term D in producing two distinct energy gaps at different antiferromagnetic zone centers. Complementary neutron diffraction and magnetization measurements as a function of applied magnetic field uncover a previously overlooked metamagnetic transition near 13 kOe and allow construction of the magnetic phase diagram in the H-T plane.

AI.tldr: 本文通过综合使用变温非弹性中子散射、中子衍射、磁化强度测量和全面的自旋波建模，解决了低维量子磁体alpha-Cu2P2O7的微观磁性模型争议，明确将其确定为bc平面内二维耦合的自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格，并揭示了其基态、激发谱和磁相图。
AI.motivation: alpha-Cu2P2O7的微观磁性模型长期存在争议，需要明确其磁基态和激发谱，以解决先前理论预测（LDA vs GGA+U）之间的分歧，并揭示该低维量子磁体的完整磁性特征。
AI.method: 采用多实验手段综合研究，包括温度依赖的非弹性中子散射、中子衍射、磁化强度测量，并结合基于LDA的密度泛函理论和系统的自旋波计算建模。
AI.result: 确立alpha-Cu2P2O7为bc平面内的二维耦合自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格，主导交换J2=7.73 meV（分子内交换）发生在第七近邻Cu-Cu对而非结构二聚体的最近邻对；弱层间耦合J5=0.03 meV在TN=25K下稳定长程反铁磁序；发现弱单离子各向异性打开自旋激发谱能隙并驱动场致变磁转变；发现先前被忽视的约13 kOe处的变磁转变并构建了H-T平面磁相图。

title: Bonding Signatures of Incipient Electron Localization in Topological Chiral Semimetals Near the Metal-Insulator Transition
comment: 24 pages, 5 figures, Supporting Information included at the end, preprint of manuscript under review at Advanced Materials
summary: How do electronic localization and delocalization compete in solids beyond the traditional limiting cases of metals and iono-covalent insulators? Topological chiral semimetals (TCSMs), characterized by their unique crystal symmetry, offer an intriguing platform to explore this question. Here, we systematically compare TCSMs with covalent compounds, ordinary metals, and metavalent solids (incipient metals), and show that TCSMs occupy a distinct region in a multidimensional property fingerprint. Atom probe tomography reveals an unusual bond-rupture signature, consistent with a bonding regime intermediate between electron localization and delocalization. This interpretation is supported by measurements of optical properties showing a transfer of spectral weight from interband to intraband transitions. For highly conductive TCSMs, this transition is accompanied by the disappearance of the Born effective charge, a measure of chemical bond polarizability, while less conductive TCSMs retain a nonzero value. Together, these results identify a property based bonding perspective on TCSMs that distinguishes them from metals, covalent solids, and metavalent compounds. Although metavalent solids and TCSMs both lie near the metal-insulator transition and exhibit distorted crystal structures, ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy reveals fundamentally different lattice-dynamical responses: a phonon-driven Peierls-like instability in metavalent solids versus a robust chiral B20 bonding motif in TCSMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了拓扑手性半金属(TCSMs)与传统共价化合物、普通金属和亚金属固体,通过原子探针断层扫描、光学性质测量和超快相干声子光谱等手段,证明TCSMs在电子局域化与退局域化之间占据了一个独特的键合区域,区别于其他材料类别。

title: A Minimal Thermodynamically Consistent Chemical Oscillator
summary: Inspired by the chemical reaction network considered as the smallest system featuring a Hopf bifurcation and its reversible extension, we introduce an even more minimal reaction network that is thermodynamically consistent and exhibits autonomous oscillations under nonequilibrium driving. The model combines three features that are rarely realized simultaneously in compact oscillator networks: a chemically plausible structure restricted to uni- and bimolecular reactions, reversibility of such reactions, and analytical tractability. The system consists of three internal species coupled to two chemostatted species and still undergoes a supercritical Hopf bifurcation when a chemostat concentration is varied. To analyze the dynamics and thermodynamics near the onset of oscillations, we employ the mathematical technique of normal-form reduction, which allows obtaining a controlled irreversible approximation that preserves the leading phase-space structure of the full reversible network while enabling explicit calculations. This framework provides analytical access to the bifurcation structure and the leading contributions governing thermodynamic observables. Within this setting, we use the onset of oscillations to characterize the thermodynamic response of the system. In particular, we offer an analytical description of key thermodynamic quantities such as the semi-grand Gibbs free energy and the non-conservative work rate, which exhibit a kink-like discontinuity at the Hopf bifurcation. We thus provide an analytical description of a phenomenon previously characterized only through numerical simulations of more complex networks.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了一个极简的三物种化学反应网络，同时具备热力学一致性、化学合理性（仅含单/双分子反应）、反应可逆性和解析可处理性。该网络在化学恒态浓度变化时经历超临界Hopf分岔，实现自主振荡。作者利用正规形约化技术获得受控的不可逆近似，从而解析地表征了分岔结构以及半巨吉布斯自由能和非保守功率等热力学量在Hopf分岔处的扭结状不连续性。
AI.motivation: 此前对振荡化学反应网络的热力学响应分析仅依赖于更复杂网络的数值模拟，缺乏解析描述。作者希望构建一个极简但热力学一致的可逆振荡网络，使得在Hopf分岔附近的热力学现象能够被解析地刻画。

AI.result: 该系统在化学恒态浓度变化时发生超临界Hopf分岔。作者解析地描述了半巨吉布斯自由能和非保守功率等热力学量，它们在该分岔点表现出扭结状（kink-like）不连续性。

title: Collective intermolecular Coulombic decay beyond Coulomb
summary: Intermolecular Coulombic decay (ICD) is a widely spread phenomenon in nature and laboratory in which the excess energy of a donor is utilized to ionize a nearby acceptor. If the excess energy is insufficiently large to enable ICD, two (or more) donors can collectively transfer their combined excess energy to ionize the acceptor. Experiments show that this collective ICD is, surprisingly, operative in gases. Recently, it has been demonstrated that standard ICD can efficiently take place at large distances between the donors and acceptors due to retardation. Here, we derive the theory of collective ICD including retardation. Quantum electrodynamics (QED) perturbation theory is used and it is shown that the theory can be substantially simplified and the process also made more amenable to interpretation by introducing two-body interaction potentials which include retardation. Explicit formulas for the rate of collective ICD are derived and interpreted by expressing the rate in terms of measurable quantities and geometric factors. It is demonstrated that the change of the permanent dipole moments of the species upon excitation is a relevant ingredient in collective ICD.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了包含延迟效应的集体分子间库仑衰变（collective ICD）理论，利用量子电动力学（QED）微扰理论，引入包含延迟的两体相互作用势来简化理论，并给出了集体ICD速率的显式公式，证明了物种激发时永久偶极矩的变化是集体ICD中的一个相关因素。
AI.motivation: 标准ICD在供体与受体距离较大时可通过延迟效应高效发生，但集体ICD（由两个或多个供体共同转移过剩能量电离受体）的延迟效应理论尚未建立，需要推导包含延迟的集体ICD理论。
AI.method: 使用量子电动力学（QED）微扰理论推导集体ICD的速率，通过引入包含延迟的两体相互作用势来简化理论，使过程更易于解释。将速率表示为可测量量与几何因子的函数。
AI.result: 推导出集体ICD速率的显式公式，证明引入两体相互作用势可显著简化理论，并发现物种激发时永久偶极矩的变化是集体ICD中的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 作者成功建立了包含延迟效应的集体ICD理论框架，为理解长距离集体ICD机制提供了理论基础，并揭示了永久偶极矩变化在该过程中的重要作用。

title: Enhanced Superconductivity in Multilayer FeSe Films by Simplified Molecular Beam Epitaxy
summary: Multi-unit-cell (UC) \b{eta}-FeSe films grown on SrTiO3(100) continue to attract attention because of the significant enhancement in the superconducting transition temperature (Tc) compared to that in bulk FeSe. In prior reports of molecular beam epitaxy (MBE)-grown \b{eta}-FeSe/SrTiO3(100), elaborate growth protocols have been used to achieve enhanced Tc, leading to a general belief that careful pre-treatment of the SrTiO3 substrate and post-growth annealing in ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) are essential. Here, we report a greatly simplified protocol for the MBE growth of superconducting multi-UC \b{eta}-FeSe films on SrTiO3(100), eliminating the need for careful substrate pre-treatment and post-growth UHV annealing while still achieving an enhanced Tc. With appropriate capping, epitaxial films with 14 UC thickness exhibit a zero-resistance transition temperature Tc ~ 20 K in ex situ electrical transport measurements. The MBE optimization process is guided by the growth-parameter dependencies of film morphology and structural properties, as characterized by reflection high-energy electron diffraction, X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy, and scanning transmission electron microscopy.

AI.tldr: 该论文报道了一种大幅简化的分子束外延（MBE）生长协议，用于在SrTiO3(100)衬底上制备多单元层（UC）β-FeSe超导薄膜。该协议无需精细的衬底预处理和超高真空（UHV）退火，即可实现增强的超导转变温度（Tc ~ 20 K）
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，要在SrTiO3(100)上获得具有增强Tc的β-FeSe薄膜，必须进行精细的衬底预处理和超高真空退火，生长流程复杂耗时。作者希望简化生长工艺，降低实验门槛。
AI.method: 作者报道了一种简化的MBE生长协议，省去了衬底精细预处理和UHV退火步骤；通过反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）、X射线衍射（XRD）、原子力显微镜（AFM）和扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）系统研究了生长参数与薄膜形貌及结构性质的关系，以此指导MBE工艺优化；并通过适当的覆盖层封盖，在离位（ex situ）电输运测量中表征超导性质。
